intervals.label: operation at the LSBB (prototype 1999-2000, Phase I 2004-2007, Phase II 2009-2010)
intervals.locator: arXiv:astro-ph/0001511, Sec. on the SIMPLE installation
intervals.note: Start: installation of the first modules 500 m underground at the LSBB began in July 1999. End: the last dated science measurement (Stage 2) ended on 22 July 2010 (arXiv:1404.4309); arXiv:1504.05475 dates Stage 2 as '2010-2011' and the Phase II analysis papers appeared until 2015, so the end of data taking is not pinned down. No source states when SIMPLE stopped.
intervals.quote: started in July 1999. A decommissioned nuclear missile control center has been converted into an underground laboratory

intervals.label: Phase I measurements in the GESA cavern
intervals.note: Years only. The 2005 paper (arXiv:hep-ex/0505053) reports four modules, 0.42 kg d.
intervals.quote: A preliminary evaluation of the original SIMPLE set-up in GESA (Phase I, 2004-2007)

intervals.label: Phase II Stage 1 science measurement
intervals.quote: science measurements conducted between 14 November 2009 - 05 February 2010 (Stage 1) and 01 May - 22 July 2010 (Stage 2)

intervals.label: Phase II Stage 2 science measurement
intervals.note: The 2012 PRL (arXiv:1106.3014) says Stage 2 data were obtained 'between 12 April - 22 July 2010'; arXiv:1504.05475 dates Stage 2 as 2010-2011. The dates here are those of the 2014 paper's science data.
intervals.quote: science measurements conducted between 14 November 2009 - 05 February 2010 (Stage 1) and 01 May - 22 July 2010 (Stage 2)

intervals.label: completed (last dated science measurement)
intervals.note: The date is the end of the last dated science measurement (22 July 2010), not a published shutdown date. No source read shows SIMPLE running after 2011, and the 2014 paper writes of Phase II in the past tense ('searched for'); arXiv:1504.05475 (2015) is a simulation study of the Phase II neutron background.
intervals.quote: science measurements conducted between 14 November 2009 - 05 February 2010 (Stage 1) and 01 May - 22 July 2010 (Stage 2)

placements.note: The experiment ran in the GESA cavern of the LSBB, 505 m beneath the Grande Montagne of the Plateau d'Albion; the site record covers the whole laboratory. Detectors were also fabricated in a 210 m.w.e. underground clean room about 1 km from GESA (arXiv:1404.4309).
placements.quote: GESA site (505 m depth) of the Laboratoire Souterrain à Bas Bruit (LSBB) in southern France

active_mass.quote: comprising a total active mass of 0.208 kg (Stage 1)

depth.quote: GESA cavern of the LSBB, located 505 m beneath

exposure.note: Phase II total; 18.24 kg d of it is science exposure after the 2014 correction.

threshold.quote: With an 8 keV recoil energy threshold imposed by temperature and pressure control

summary.plain: Small bottles of gel holding droplets of a freon liquid (C2ClF5), sunk in a shielded water pool; each bubble that forms is recorded by microphones.
summary.technical: Phase II: two arrays of 15 C2ClF5 SDDs (active mass 0.208 kg in Stage 1, 0.215 kg in Stage 2) in a 700 L water pool with water and polyethylene shielding, operated at 2 bar and 8 keV threshold; acoustic recoil/alpha discrimination better than 99% (arXiv:1404.4309).

technology.quote: searched for astroparticle dark matter using superheated liquid C$_{2}$ClF$_{5}$ droplet detectors
technology.value: Superheated C2ClF5 droplet detectors with acoustic readout
